data.name: Pixel Game Maker Series WEAPON USER
data.detailed_description:
■ System

The controls consist of Light Attack, Medium Attack, Heavy Attack, Special Move, Super Move, and Close-Range Attack (equivalent to a throw).
Special and Super Moves can be unleashed easily with simple directional button combinations.

〇 Secret Fist System

A powerful move that can be used once per round. It can be canceled from certain normal attacks and makes it relatively easy to chain into combos or Super Moves when it hits.

〇 Game Modes

You can choose from the following modes: "STORY MODE", "VERSUS MODE", and "TRAINING".

〇 STORY MODE

Choose one of six characters, each wielding unique weapons like nunchaku, tonfa, or brass knuckles, and fight your way to victory.
Defeat seven opponents to complete the game. Even if you lose along the way, you can continue as many times as you like.

〇 VERSUS MODE

1P and 2P each choose a character and fight to determine the winner.
After each match, both players select their characters again.

〇 TRAINING

Choose a character and practice their moves.
You can train in standing, crouching, or jumping positions.

〇 Hidden Features

Each time you clear “STORY MODE,” hidden elements will be unlocked. Hidden characters, character costumes, and other items will be unlocked.

■ Story

Weapon Battles are one-on-one duels using specific weapons.
Participants are known as Weapon Users, and the battles became popular among delinquents.
One day, a “Breaker” appears—someone who goes beyond the rules and violently assaults defeated opponents.
With the rise of the Breaker, the Weapon Battles descend into chaos.

Various settings

You can configure various settings such as operation settings and language display from “F1” → “Settings”.

data.short_description: "WEAPON USER" is a 2D versus fighting game where you can unleash authentic combos with simple controls. Enjoy the game in "STORY MODE" for single-player action, or battle it out in "VERSUS MODE" with 1P vs 2P gameplay.
